snippet.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Cost of Hope & 2.0 Update — Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
The worldwide reception of the new chapter of S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 warms us like a campfire on a cold autumn night at Yaniv — and we’re happy to share a spark of it with you.
S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Cost of Hope and Update 2.0 marked a significant evolution of the Zone. Now, She proudly calls to everyone — be it a seasoned stalker who postponed their journey or a rookie who never dared to venture out before — to experience and endure the dangers, wonders, and stories that await within.

Already available: 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3765020/STALKER_2_Cost_of_Hope/
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/stalker-2-cost-of-hope/9mxv6p2fnddc
PlayStation 5: https://www.playstation.com/games/stalker-2-heart-of-chornobyl 
GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/stalker_2_cost_of_hope
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/stalker-2-heart-of-chornobyl--cost-of-hope
